t: The $(5)Scale Module$() can be placed in the upgrade slots of various MFFS machines to upgrade their distance capabilities. Its effects vary depending on the machine, but most commonly include: $(li)Incrasing force field size$(li)Increasing interdiction area$(li)Increasing the fuel boost in a $(l:mffs:machines/coercion_deriver)Coercion Deriver$()
$(5)扩展模块$()可被置入各类MFFS机器的升级插槽中，以提升其作用距离能力。其具体效果因机器而异，但最常见的是：$(li)增大力场尺寸$(li)扩大拦截区域$(li)提升$(l:mffs:machines/coercion_deriver)Fortron 衍生器$()的燃料增益
